# ScribeCat 0.24.10

- Confine desktop trackpad pinch-to-zoom to the PDF viewer.
- Reset the zoom control to 100% when it is closed.
- Support mouse drag/panning and touch panning while zoomed.
- Use grab/grabbing cursors for zoomed PDF panning.
- Preserve selectable PDF text and existing mobile pinch-to-zoom behavior.

Compare: v0.24.9...v0.24.10
